livelihood_summary: Highly productive surplus rain-fed farming with some livestock, fishing, hunting and forest products; good cross-border markets
main_crops: Maize, sorghum, groundnuts, soya, cassava, sweet potatoes, rice, vegetables; Robusta coffee as cash crop
seasonal_calendar: Two rainy seasons (Mar-Jun, Aug-Nov); land preparation Jan-Mar; planting mid-Mar to May; cereal harvest Jul-Aug and Nov-Dec
main_hazards: Dry spells May-Jul (about every 2 years); river and stream floods Aug-Oct (about every 4 years); crop pests every rainy season; conflict and insecurity
coping_and_notes: Wild foods, bush product and charcoal sales, labor migration, remittances, livestock sales
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.10-13

livelihood_summary: Moderately productive agro-pastoral zone: cereals and legumes, cattle and small livestock
main_crops: Sorghum (main), millet, maize, groundnut, sesame, cassava, sweet potatoes, vegetables
seasonal_calendar: Single rainy season Apr-early Nov; land preparation Feb-Mar; planting Apr-May; weeding Jun-Jul; lean season Jun-Jul; groundnut and sesame harvest from Aug, sorghum from Oct
main_hazards: Drought about every 12 years; annual crop pests and livestock disease; periodic river floods; inter-clan conflict
coping_and_notes: Poor sell firewood, charcoal, grass, mats, shea oil, wild foods and labor; better-off sell sorghum, millet, cattle and honey
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.14-17

livelihood_summary: Cereal-deficit agricultural zone with minor livestock; single growing season; access to wild foods and gold extraction
main_crops: Maize, sorghum, millet, groundnuts, cowpeas, sweet potatoes, vegetables
seasonal_calendar: Rainy season Apr-Nov; dry planting from March; weeding Apr-Jun; harvest from Aug; dry spells Jun-Jul; lean season Jun-Aug
main_hazards: Floods at least once every 2 years in the rainy season (Apr-Nov); mid-season dry spells May-Jun; annual crop pests; conflict
coping_and_notes: Sale of charcoal, bamboo, wild game, honey, gold and agricultural labor
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.18-21

zone_name: Western plains groundnuts, sesame and sorghum
livelihood_summary: Subsistence rain-fed farming with forest products, seasonal fishing and small livestock; formerly a surplus area
main_crops: Groundnuts and sesame (cash), sorghum, maize, cassava, cowpeas, pumpkins, vegetables
seasonal_calendar: Rainy season Apr-Oct; land preparation Feb-Apr; planting May to mid-Jun; weeding mid-Jun to Jul; green harvest from Sep; sorghum and sesame harvested in March
main_hazards: Dry spells and late season start about every 2 years (May-Jun); crop pests Jun-Dec; livestock disease; cross-border conflict; price spikes
coping_and_notes: Groundnut sales; natural product sales (charcoal, grass, bamboo, honey, shea); sorghum in-kind labor
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.22-24

livelihood_summary: Pastoral with very limited cropping; milk, meat, blood and wild foods; food mainly bought or exchanged for livestock
main_crops: Sorghum (small amounts, mostly bought); milk and blood
seasonal_calendar: Rainy season Jun-Oct; seasonal livestock migration to grazing and water; livestock-for-grain trade
main_hazards: Inter-communal conflict and cattle raiding (dry season Nov-Feb); flooding Jul-Oct; livestock disease; drought
coping_and_notes: Livestock sales, herding and domestic labor, gold mining, charcoal and wild foods
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.25-27

livelihood_summary: Agro-pastoral: rain-fed cultivation and cattle, with fishing, hunting and wild foods; known cereal deficit area
seasonal_calendar: Rainy season Mar-Oct; land preparation Jan-Feb; planting Apr-Jun; weeding Jun-Aug; harvest Aug-Nov; lean season May-Jul; livestock migration Dec-Apr
main_hazards: Flooding every year Jul-Oct; livestock disease May-Nov; crop pests Jun-Sep; drought once in three years; cattle raiding Feb-May
coping_and_notes: Own cereal now lasts 2-4 months instead of 9; poor households sell charcoal, firewood, goats and labor; Sobat and Nile are central to livestock movement
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.28-30

zone_name: Northwestern flood plain sorghum and cattle
livelihood_summary: Classic agro-pastoral flood-plain system; cereal deficit imported from Sudan; cattle sold to Sudan; fishing and wild foods
main_crops: Sorghum (staple), maize, pearl millet, legumes, sesame, groundnuts
seasonal_calendar: Rainy season May-Oct; dry period peaks Jan-Apr; land preparation Mar-Apr; planting May-Jul; green harvest Aug-Sep; main harvest Oct-Nov
main_hazards: Rainfall variability; flash floods in low-lying areas Jul-Aug; striga and fall armyworm; livestock disease; conflict
coping_and_notes: Sale of labor, fish, wild foods and small livestock; better-off sell livestock and crops
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.31-34

livelihood_summary: Fishing, rain-fed cropping, livestock and wild foods on a narrow swampy floodplain along the Nile; river ports critical for trade
main_crops: Sorghum (staple), maize, cowpeas, groundnuts, vegetables (okra, pumpkins)
seasonal_calendar: Fishing year-round, lowest in the rains; land preparation Feb-Mar; harvest Sep-Nov; vegetables in dry season; livestock sales Feb-Jul; fish sales Jan-Apr and Aug-Nov
main_hazards: Flooding every 3-5 years plus the annual river rise; crop pests; livestock disease; localized cattle raiding
coping_and_notes: Sorghum harvest normally lasts 6-7 months, now 2-4; poor households sell fish, firewood, papyrus mats and brew
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.35-37

zone_name: North-western Nile basin cattle and maize
livelihood_summary: Livestock-focused agro-pastoral; maize is main staple; fishing and wild foods; deficit cereal producer relying on trade
seasonal_calendar: Rainy season May-Nov; dry spell May-Jun; floods Jul-Aug; livestock disease peaks Feb-Apr; fishing mostly in dry season
main_hazards: Floods Jul-Aug; dry spell May-Jun; bird plagues; striga and fall armyworm; dry-season cattle raiding
coping_and_notes: Poor households may buy up to 9 months of staples instead of 2-3; sell goats, sheep, labor and bush products
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.38-40

livelihood_summary: Sobat River flood plain: maize, cattle and fishing; predictable annual inundation; net cereal importer; isolated, few trading opportunities
main_crops: Maize (main, two seasons), sorghum, cowpeas, vegetables
seasonal_calendar: Rainy season May-Oct (maize planted May); flood-recession maize from Nov, harvested late Feb-Mar; dry period most critical Jan-Apr; milk peaks Jul-Oct; peak goat and cattle sales Jun-Jul
main_hazards: Rainfall interruption in Jun-Jul; sudden swing to heavy rain early in the season; annual swamp inundation Aug-Sep (expected, not classed as flood); crop pests; livestock disease
coping_and_notes: Labor migration, sale of natural products, dried fish, goats and cattle
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.41-43

livelihood_summary: Semi-arid agro-pastoral with riverine area along the Nile; mechanized farming near the river; overall cereal deficit
seasonal_calendar: Single rainy season May-Oct; land preparation late Mar-early May; planting May-Jun; sorghum harvest Oct-Nov; own crops exhausted May-Aug; cattle sales May-Aug; milk peak to December
main_hazards: Floods every 2-3 years Aug-Oct; delayed or interrupted rains every 3-5 years around Jun-Jul; sorghum rust, grasshoppers, birds; livestock disease
coping_and_notes: Local and seasonal labor, livestock and crop sales, fish, wild foods, retail trade
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.44-46

zone_name: Maize, sorghum, fish and natural resources
livelihood_summary: South-eastern Jonglei highlands and lowlands bordering Ethiopia: agriculture with livestock, fishing and natural resources
main_crops: Maize, sorghum, groundnuts, cassava (bridges shortfalls Jan-Jul)
seasonal_calendar: Rainy season Mar-Dec; land preparation Feb; planting Mar; weeding Apr; first harvest Jul-Aug; second season from Sep, harvest from Dec; short dry season Jan-Feb
main_hazards: Floods every year in the wet season; livestock disease in the dry season; dry spells every 2-3 years; cattle rustling in the dry season; human disease peaks in the wet season
coping_and_notes: Labor, natural products (grass, firewood, charcoal), goat and sheep sales, wild foods and fish
source: FEWS NET South Sudan Livelihood Zone Map and Descriptions, Aug 2018, p.47-50
